Line 1 — For individuals, subtract your standard deduction or itemized deductions from your adjusted gross income (AGI) and enter it here. For estates and trusts, enter taxable income increased by the total of the charitable deduction, income distribution deduction, and exemption amount
Line 2 — Nonbusiness capital losses before limitation. Enter as a positive number
Line 3 — Nonbusiness capital gains (without regard to any section 1202 exclusion)
Line 4 — If line 2 is more than line 3, enter the difference. Otherwise, enter -0-
Line 5 — If line 3 is more than line 2, enter the difference. Otherwise, enter -0-
Line 6 — Nonbusiness deductions (see instructions). Enter as a positive number
Line 7 — Nonbusiness income other than capital gains (see instructions)
Line 8 — Add lines 5 and 7
Line 9 — If line 6 is more than line 8, enter the difference. Otherwise, enter -0-
Line 10 — If line 8 is more than line 6, enter the difference. Otherwise, enter -0-. But don't enter more than line 5
Line 11 — Business capital losses before limitation. Enter as a positive number
Line 12 — Business capital gains (without regard to any section 1202 exclusion)
Line 13 — Add lines 10 and 12
Line 14 — Subtract line 13 from line 11. If zero or less, enter -0-
Line 15 — Add lines 4 and 14

Line 16 — Enter, if any, the combined net short-term and long-term capital loss from your Schedule D (Form 1040). Estates and trusts, enter, if any, the total net short-term and long-term loss from Schedule D (Form 1041). Enter as a positive number
Line 17 — Section 1202 exclusion. Enter as a positive number
Line 18 — Subtract line 17 from line 16. If zero or less, enter -0-
Line 19 — If line 16 is a loss, enter, as a positive number, the smaller of the loss on line 16 or $3,000 ($1,500 when married filing separately on Form 1040)
Line 20 — If line 18 is more than line 19, enter the difference. Otherwise, enter -0-
Line 21 — If line 19 is more than line 18, enter the difference. Otherwise, enter -0-
Line 22 — Subtract line 20 from line 15. If zero or less, enter -0-
Line 23 — NOL deduction for losses from other years. Enter as a positive number
Line 24 — NOL. Combine lines 1, 9, 17, and 21 through 23. If the result is less than zero, enter it here
